status: Capacity fairness memo; no large control fit/native execution
conclusion: A vector-budget comparison and a same-allocated-LSB comparison answer different questions. They must both be reported. On these frozen single-layer inventories, full A1 plus Down14, and even full complementary A1+A2 plus Down14, admit the same32LSBblocks as the prefix candidate. Therefore a single-layer allocated-capacity saving cannot be inferred from the56MiB programmed increment.

budgets.name: Explicit resource-vector dominance control
budgets.definition: Require useful coefficient bytes,programmed pages,resident waves and allocated blocks each not to exceed the candidate, with per-chip/fault-domain constraints declared. Keep baseline resident weights/metadata and shared geometry common.
budgets.answers: How much latency can be bought with the same explicit multi-resource increment? This is legitimate but stricter than capacity-only fairness.
budgets.not_equivalent: Do not label this the only same-physical-capacity control when available allocated blocks contain usable holes.

budgets.name: Same allocated LSB physical capacity control
budgets.definition: Permit the baseline to fill any legal holes in the same per-chip allocated blocks. Useful/pages/waves may exceed the candidate while total allocated LSB space and hardware capacities stay equal. Repack all resident maximal row images; do not demand old offsets remain fixed.
budgets.answers: Does prefix sharing buy performance or model fit at equal physical capacity?
budgets.not_equivalent: A total block-count match alone is insufficient if it changes per-chip or LUN budgets. This case has a constructive2blocks/chip control; still emit/check addresses and one-copy+replica row identities.

budgets.name: Full-model global packing/Pareto
budgets.definition: Pack all40layers and unchanged shared/base weights together, within existing per-chip/native one-block constraints. Compare global allocated blocks,per-chip capacities and model fit as well as useful/pages/waves.
budgets.answers: Whether page/wave savings persist after block-step slack is amortized.
budgets.not_equivalent: Neither32L0blocks*40 nor the single-layer extra896W*40 is a proof of globally optimal allocated capacity; report bounds and feasible physical certificates separately.

primary_service_match_control.name: Separate full A1 GU images + original B + Down14
primary_service_match_control.construction: Keep original B cores and Down14 paired images. Store every selected A1 source128-row GU image separately, with EXACT Bcore|sameappend row order. A long source request reads its A1copy; a short source reads original Bcore; offsource B-prefix requests and logical row scatter remain as in candidate.
primary_service_match_control.selector: Replay exactly the candidate per-query per-source u bits, including dependent offsource ranges, and Down14merge bits in the original job order. This preserves the candidate policy freedom; do not replace it by only one whole-expert A/B bit.
primary_service_match_control.equivalence_scope: Same C/rows/pages/waves/commands/input/output and GU->fullA8->Down descriptors imply identical service in the current address-invariant native model. Short-prefix fringe values may differ but discarded outputs cannot alter valid rows under the already-required row-separable/reset contract. No new native equivalence or numeric hardware measurement was executed.
primary_service_match_control.attribution: Prefix sharing saves useful/programmed/resident-wave storage versus this control. Runtime latency comes from adaptive geometry/packet placement/selector. Equal allocated blocks plus service matching removes a single-layer allocated-capacity advantage, not every possible full-model or programmed-byte advantage.

stronger_control.name: Add full complementary A2 GU images
stronger_control.capacity: Exactly192GUbackup waves/chip for A1+A2; base+Down14 at most189waves/chip. Simple two-block packing exists in this model.
stronger_control.performance: Additional source choices may help but require fair TRAIN-only fitting and the same native coalescing/barriers. No measured or strict performance domination claimed; the original A1 policy is retained as an available control.

required_if_joint_passes_gate: First emit the service-matching A1 physical image/address+rowID certificate and replay identical candidate bits/job order. This is an attribution check,not a new optimization campaign.

Fit whole-GU and whole-Down alternatives independently under the explicit vector budget;do not force whole-FFN backups. Include37GU,21GU+32Down,and5GU+all64Down allocation corners if chip packing allows. Fit expert IDs,chip masks,legal geometries and choices with equal TRAIN effort.

Run same-allocated controls starting from the exact-match A1 incumbent,then A1+A2 and selective complete/packet replicas permitted by remaining holes. Preserve all incumbents and compare marginal-hotness/routeblind plus query-aware fits.

Sweep a small capacity Pareto: no-copy,GUonly512W,Downonly384W,joint896W, and the completeA1/A1+A2 physical budgets. Report useful bytes,programmed pages,resident waves,per-chip allocated blocks,global fit and latency together.

Retain strong one-copy/static mixed geometry and same-image static packet/view controls;keep shared geometry,fullGU/fullA8 barrier,input fanout,command costs,host scatter and selector costs identical.
Before a full-model capacity claim,global-pack every family and report feasible plans/lower bounds. A single-layer block step cannot establish or erase all model-wide savings.

reusable_existing_selectors.reuse: GU v3 independent-source u_i assembly, computed-versus-consumed row ledger and dependent offsource prefixes;relabel long reads to full A1 addresses while preserving the exact selected job order.
reusable_existing_selectors.limit: Existing native script supplies finite greedy/representative evaluation,not an optimal copy selector or a generalized full-model fit.

reusable_existing_selectors.reuse: Graph14 merge_bits,complete128/256 row images,fullGU barrier and trace comparison scaffolding.
reusable_existing_selectors.limit: Retain the packet-consistency constraints;flow/LP relaxation is not itself a feasible runtime policy.

reusable_existing_selectors.reuse: Exact64choice necessary minmax-work oracle for six whole-expert binary choices,usable for simple backup placement screens.
reusable_existing_selectors.limit: Not an exact selector for84independent GU+Down bits/top6 or a native scheduling optimum.

reusable_existing_selectors.reuse: TRAIN-only source-mask/replica-location and static incumbent fitting patterns;retain same source/copy-budget accounting.
reusable_existing_selectors.limit: Its original free-mask search is not same-budget constrained;add exact physical budgets before labeling a fair control.

prior_scope: Reuse the immediately preceding primary-source audits of query-log replicated declustering,overlapping fragmentations,HDA and Tutel;no fresh literature search or unread-fulltext claims. These establish the control families,not the NAND native contract.
no_new_claim: No new algorithm/theorem,hardware extension,manufactured-chip performance,global optimum or heldout result claimed.
